lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: I am so tired. Do you think we can go back home to eat?

options.text: We can't go back until we find mom

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: We should continue. Your mom could be at the Red Palace. That is miles away. Or she could be in the Red Village, near here..

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: The Red Palace it is then. It's a long journey, but we'll make it.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: Let's gather supplies and head out. Stay sharp, everyone.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: Red Village sounds closer. Maybe we can rest there too.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: Good thinking. Let's move before it gets dark.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: There. A city gate. Finally, walls that are not trying to kill us.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: Smells like food. And smoke. And... coins.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Travelers! Dusty, hungry, and carrying that 'about to spend money' look. Step right up.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: We need food, bandages, and anything that keeps us alive.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Ah, the classic bundle. Rations, salves, and a little charm against bad luck. Luck not included.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: Show me what is small, useful, and does not explode.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Then you want light blades, smoke pellets, and a lockpick kit. None of those explode on purpose.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: We are looking for my mom. Have you seen her? She would have passed through.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Lots of mothers. Lots of trouble. Describe her.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: Do not say 'mother-shaped.'

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: She wears a red scarf. And she always looks like she knows something you do not.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Red scarf... I heard of one like that. Bought a map. Asked about the Red Palace road.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: She left at dawn with a caravan. Said something about not trusting the quiet path.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: Quiet paths are always loud with knives.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: Then we take the caravan road.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: A city map with a mark: an inn in the next city. Like she planned to stop there.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: An inn. Good. She is alive enough to need sleep.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: Or alive enough to set a trap. Let us hope for the first one.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: The Lantern Inn. Near the river. Hard to miss. Unless you are trying to miss it.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: We are not trying to miss it.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: Speak for yourself. But yes, we go.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Look with your eyes, not with your hands. Hands cost extra.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: I can afford hands. I prefer not to.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: Do you have anything that makes walking feel like less walking?

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Sure. Good shoes. That will be five coins and one prayer.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: Pleasure doing business. Try not to bleed on the goods next time.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: We will do our best. No promises.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: Let us move before I buy something irresponsible.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: A refined choice. For refined crimes.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: For refined survival.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: Same thing, honestly.

lines.speaker: merchant
lines.text: These will carry you far. Or at least, farther than despair.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: Finally, footwear that understands my emotional arc.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: We are leaving. Now.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: Next stop: the city by the river. The Lantern Inn.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: If mom was there, we will find a clue. Or a warm meal. Ideally both.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: River city. I can hear water. I can also hear my stomach threatening rebellion.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: Keep your coins close. Crowds have fingers.

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: Welcome to the Lantern Inn. If you are here to cause trouble, please do it quietly.

options.text: Ask about a woman with a red scarf

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: Two beds. And a door that locks.

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: Two beds, one door, one key. Do not lose the key. The key has feelings.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: We will take it.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: Did a woman with a red scarf stay here?

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: Maybe. Many guests, many scarves. Red stands out though.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: We are not here for poetry. Did she pay? Did she leave a message?

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: She did both. Paid for one night. Left at dusk. Asked me to give this to 'the tired one.'

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: A folded note. Smells like lamp oil and impatience.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: That sounds like her.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: Read it. Out loud. Slowly. No dramatic pauses.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: It says: 'do not go to the palace by the main road. find the stone bridge. trust the lantern.'

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: Stone bridge. Lantern. Either guidance or an elaborate pun.

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: She asked about the stone bridge outside the city. Said it was safer than the main road.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: She is always ten steps ahead.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: Then we sleep, and take those ten steps in the morning.

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: Stew is hot. Bread is warm. Questions are extra.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: I will pay in silence and chewing.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: I will pay in watching everyone else chew.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: Beds. Real beds. I could cry, but I will settle for sleeping.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: I will take first watch. You sleep. If the lantern means anything, we will need you alive tomorrow.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: Wake me if you hear anything.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: I always hear everything.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: Dawn. No one stabbed us in our sleep. A productive night.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: Stone bridge, then. And the Red Palace after that.

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: Travel safe. And if you find the lady with the red scarf, tell her she still owes me a story.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: No. We sleep. Exhaustion makes idiots of heroes.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: Fine. One night. Then we chase the lantern.

lines.speaker: innkeeper
lines.text: Wise. Reckless guests pay more for sheets.
